en: The Kāṇḍānukramaṇī of the Kāṭhaka Śruti Śrāddha, 24, 283 (in the Kāṭhaka).
Āśvalāyana Gṛhya Sūtra 79, 80, 88, 92, 93, 100, 106, 107, 110, 126, 132, 160; Kātyāyana Gṛhya Śrāddha Sūtra 323.
The author of the *Gṛhyabhāṣyasaṃgraha*, Śrāddha 328, 329 (perhaps referring to the *ĀpGṛ* and its commentary),
Tantracintādhyāya (The Chapter on the Deliberation of Systems)
Dhāreśvara, author of the *Vya* (Vyavahārakāṇḍa) section of the *Dharmaśāstra*, verse 602.
Āśauca 6, 8, 9, 24, 36, 127 (note: in the *Śrī Viṣṇupurāṇa*, Parāśara states [this] at Śrāddha 8, 22).
Baijavāpa Gṛhya Śrāddha Sūtra 3.24, Baudhāyana School.
The Vāsiṣṭha-Siddhānta, Chapter 108: On Usury and Śrāddha Rites.
Smṛti Saṃ 26 (anonymous), 30–31 (anonymous, on things forbidden in the Kali age), 42, 121, 122, 124, 183.
Garuḍa Purāṇa, Śrāddha Chapters 65 and 67; Tvaṣṭṛ Purāṇa.
Āśauca: 4, 33, 68, 69, 70, 70, 72, 98–99, 102, 108, 109, 111, 121, 177, 178 (occupying three pages!), 193; from the Brahmakaivarta Purāṇa.
